pierre.subject: A single irregular gray stone
pierre.details: Rounded asymmetrical rock silhouette, composed of large and medium polygonal facets with subtle fine mineral surface detail.
pierre.palette: Cool slate-gray and pale gray surfaces, darker charcoal-gray lower faces.
pierre.ownerPrompt: A single irregular gray stone, premium stylized 3D low-poly game resource icon. Rounded asymmetrical rock silhouette, composed of large and medium polygonal facets with subtle fine mineral surface detail. Cool slate-gray and pale gray surfaces, softly illuminated by a warm golden-white key light from the upper left. Delicate highlights along a few facet edges, darker charcoal-gray lower faces, soft ambient occlusion between facets. Slight three-quarter view, centered, visually substantial and readable at small sizes. Modern polished fantasy mining game aesthetic, sophisticated but not photorealistic, neither cartoon emoji nor flat vector art. One isolated rock only. No text, no border, no UI card, no pedestal, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object. True transparent alpha background. Square 1024x1024 canvas, object occupying approximately 75 percent of canvas, consistent margins.
pierre.note: Première génération sans référence (consigne du propriétaire du 29/10/2026) : le prompt envoyé est ownerPrompt, mot pour mot.
pierre.validated: 2026-10-29 — proposition C (pierre-20261029-215555-c) retenue par le propriétaire

charbon.subject: A single irregular lump of raw coal
charbon.details: Rounded asymmetrical chunk with the same silhouette scale as the reference stone, composed of large and medium sharp polygonal facets; a few facets have a subtle glassy sheen typical of anthracite, with fine mineral surface detail.
charbon.palette: Deep charcoal-black and very dark graphite surfaces with faint cool blue-gray reflections on the lit facets, near-black lower faces; it must stay clearly readable against a dark brown-black background.
charbon.validated: 2026-10-30 — proposition C retenue par le propriétaire

minerai_fer.subject: A single irregular chunk of iron ore
minerai_fer.details: The same faceted gray rock as the reference stone, with several embedded metallic iron nodules and veins breaking through the facets, plus small patches of rusty oxidation around them.
minerai_fer.palette: Cool slate-gray rock surfaces, steel-gray metallic inclusions with bright silver highlights, warm rust-orange and reddish-brown oxide patches, darker charcoal-gray lower faces.
minerai_fer.validated: 2026-10-30 — proposition C retenue par le propriétaire

diamant.subject: A single rough natural diamond crystal
diamant.details: Uncut mineral diamond as found in a mine: a slightly irregular octahedron with softly rounded edges and triangular faces showing natural etch pits, growth steps and a frosted, partly matte surface, with small clear glassy windows that reveal strong adamantine brilliance; a few dark gray kimberlite rock fragments still cling to its base; same silhouette scale as the reference stone. Clearly a precious raw gemstone: not an ice cube, not frozen water, not glass, not a jewelry cut.
diamant.palette: Mostly colorless white and pale silver-gray crystal with a very faint warm champagne tint, intense white sparkles and small prismatic rainbow flashes (fire) on the lit edges, soft cool gray lower faces, dark gray kimberlite; it must stay readable against a deep blue background.
diamant.previous: 2026-10-30 pilote C (diamant-20261030-095353-c) refusé par le propriétaire : ressemble à un glaçon

terre_meuble.subject: A single irregular clump of loose brown soil
terre_meuble.details: Rounded crumbly mound with the same silhouette scale as the reference stone, built from many small and medium soft polygonal clods and granules, with a few tiny pebbles and thin dry root fibers; matte, earthy, clearly loose dirt rather than rock.
terre_meuble.palette: Warm chocolate-brown and medium umber surfaces with lighter tan crumbs on the lit side, dark coffee-brown lower faces; it must stay readable against a dark brown background.

argile.subject: A single dense lump of raw clay
argile.details: Compact rounded chunk with the same silhouette scale as the reference stone, smoother and softer than rock: broad gently bevelled polygonal faces, a slightly moist satin sheen and a few shallow finger-pressed dents and fine cracks.
argile.palette: Terracotta reddish-orange and warm ochre surfaces with soft peach highlights, deep rust-brown lower faces; it must stay readable against a brown-orange background.

gres.subject: A single irregular chunk of sandstone
gres.details: The same faceted rock as the reference stone, but with clearly visible horizontal sedimentary layers running across the facets and a fine sandy granular surface texture.
gres.palette: Warm beige, sand-yellow and pale ochre strata alternating with light rose-tan bands, muted brown lower faces; it must stay readable against a warm gray background.

granite.subject: A single irregular chunk of granite
granite.details: The same faceted rock as the reference stone, slightly more angular and dense, with a polished speckled crystalline surface: a clear granular pattern of black, white and salmon-pink mineral grains (feldspar, quartz, mica) across every facet.
granite.palette: Medium gray base speckled with black, milky white and salmon-pink grains, tiny glinting mica flecks, charcoal lower faces; it must stay readable against a very dark zinc-gray background.

minerai_or.subject: A single irregular chunk of gold ore
minerai_or.details: The same faceted gray rock as the reference stone, with several bright embedded gold nuggets and branching gold veins breaking through the facets, plus a few tiny quartz specks.
minerai_or.palette: Cool slate-gray rock surfaces, rich metallic gold inclusions with warm yellow highlights and amber shadows, darker charcoal-gray lower faces; it must stay readable against an amber-orange background.

vieille_caisse.subject: A single small old weathered wooden crate
vieille_caisse.details: Closed square crate made of rough, slightly warped wooden planks with a diagonal brace, a few rusty nails, a cracked corner and a frayed rope loop, rendered in the same faceted low-poly style and silhouette scale as the reference stone; humble and worn, clearly a common find. The crate is fully isolated on a perfectly transparent background: no dark backdrop, no vignette, no glow or halo behind it.
vieille_caisse.palette: Faded gray-brown and dusty honey-brown wood with darker grain lines, rusty brown nail heads, deep brown lower faces; it must stay readable against a dark brown background.
vieille_caisse.retry: 2026-10-30 : première génération (vieille_caisse-20261030-121419-a) refusée par process.js (fond opaque), relancée une seule fois

coffre_bois.subject: A single closed wooden treasure chest
coffre_bois.details: Classic chest with a rounded barrel lid, sturdy wooden planks, polished brass corner fittings, two brass bands and a small golden lock plate, rendered in the same faceted low-poly style, three-quarter view and silhouette scale as the reference stone; a tiny warm golden glow escapes from the lid seam.
coffre_bois.palette: Rich warm reddish-brown wood with lighter caramel highlights, shiny brass and gold metal fittings, dark mahogany lower faces; it must stay readable against a brown-orange background.

coffre_fer.subject: A single closed iron-bound treasure chest
coffre_fer.details: Heavy chest with a flat-topped bevelled lid, dark wooden panels almost entirely covered by riveted steel plates and thick iron bands, reinforced corners and a large ornate steel padlock, rendered in the same faceted low-poly style, three-quarter view and silhouette scale as the reference stone; it looks valuable and epic.
coffre_fer.palette: Cool steel-gray and gunmetal plates with bright silver edge highlights, small hints of dark walnut wood between the plates, a faint cool blue sheen, near-black lower faces; it must stay readable against a dark slate-blue background.

rubis.subject: A single raw ruby crystal
rubis.details: Rough natural ruby: a stubby hexagonal tabular crystal with slightly uneven flat faces, natural growth steps and a few small chips, with the same silhouette scale as the reference stone; a mineral specimen, not a cut jewel, not glass.
rubis.palette: Deep crimson and blood-red translucent facets with bright pinkish-red internal glow and crisp white sparkles on the lit edges, dark wine-red lower faces; it must stay readable against a red background.

emeraude.subject: A small cluster of raw emerald crystals
emeraude.details: Rough natural emerald specimen: two or three elongated hexagonal prism crystals with flat terminations growing from a small fragment of pale gray host rock, natural inclusions and growth lines, same overall silhouette scale as the reference stone; a mineral specimen, not a cut jewel, not glass.
emeraude.palette: Vivid emerald-green and deep forest-green translucent crystals with bright mint highlights and white sparkles on the lit edges, dark bottle-green lower faces, pale gray host rock; it must stay readable against a green background.
